topic: Chinese open models beating the paid ones
angle: Four of the five leading open models come from Chinese labs, with free weights
hook: China is giving away models the West charges for
caption:
Four of the five leading open models in 2026 come from Chinese labs — DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu and Alibaba. They publish weights, several under genuinely permissive licences, and they have closed most of the coding and reasoning gap with the closed frontier.

🔖 Save this — the links are all free.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#ai #opensource #deepseek #qwen #llm #technews

slides.text: China is *giving away* models the West charges for
slides.subline: Free weights. Permissive licences. Right now

slides.text: Open weights used to mean second-rate. In 2026 four of the five leading open models are Chinese, and they are not second-rate.

items.title: Kimi K3
items.desc: 2.8T params. Biggest open model there is

items.title: GLM 5.2
items.desc: Strongest at tool use and agents

slides.title: Check the licence, not the benchmark
slides.body: DeepSeek ships MIT and Qwen ships Apache 2.0 — you can build a business on either. Some others are open weights but restricted use. The licence decides what you are allowed to sell.

slides.left_text: Per-token billing, usage caps, and the price is whatever they decide next quarter.
slides.right_text: Download once, run anywhere, and nobody can reprice it out from under you.

slides.title: You do not need a GPU
slides.body: Rent one. An A100 is about $1.69 an hour, so an evening of experimenting costs less than lunch. Owning hardware is the expensive way to find out if this works for you.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
